description: This file is a Python script for a plugin skeleton generator, involving user prompts, YAML configuration parsing, interface parsing, and code generation coordination.

methods.name: loadYAML
methods.description: Loads a YAML configuration file, handling errors and file existence.

methods.name: validatePaths
methods.description: Checks if provided file paths exist, exits on missing files.

methods.name: collectList
methods.description: Collects user input into a list until an empty line is entered.

methods.name: prompts
methods.description: Prompts user for plugin configuration details and interface paths.

methods.name: parserInterfaces
methods.description: Parses header files to extract interface classes and header info.

methods.name: displayParsedData
methods.description: Displays parsed interface data in a formatted manner.

methods.name: _root
methods.description: Extracts the root name from a fully qualified interface name.

methods.name: menu
methods.description: Main function to run the plugin generator, handling config or prompts, parsing interfaces, and invoking code generation.
